issues.description: The problem statement (and UML) specify Animal.messageOnFeed() returns a String, and the template code expects an Animal type with such a method; however the solution changes the abstract method to return FeedResponse instead of String. This return-type change across artifacts is a structural mismatch that will confuse students about the correct signature and prevents straightforward implementation according to the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent with the problem statement: change Animal.messageOnFeed() in the solution to return String (and update Pig, Seal, Goat to return String). Remove or adapt FeedResponse usage so the abstract method and all overrides use String, or alternatively update the problem statement and template to explicitly require FeedResponse if that is the intended design.

issues.description: Inside the solution repository there is an internal inconsistency: Animal.messageOnFeed() is declared to return FeedResponse, but Goat.messageOnFeed() is implemented returning String. This mismatch makes the solution code non-compilable and will confuse students reading the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution internally consistent: either change Animal.messageOnFeed() to return String and have Goat (and other animals) return String, or change Goat.messageOnFeed() to return FeedResponse (and ensure its returned FeedResponse is constructed appropriately). Also ensure FeedResponse is documented or removed to match the chosen design.

issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify Animal.messageOnFeed() as an abstract method returning String, but the solution implementation changes the method to return a FeedResponse object (and adds a FeedResponse class). This alters the expected API/contract for the core Animal concept and creates a mismatch between the task description/template expectations (String messages) and the solution (FeedResponse), likely confusing students about the required return type and how to implement messageOnFeed().
issues.suggestedFix: Align the API across artifacts. Either revert the solution to match the problem statement by making messageOnFeed() return String in Animal and all subclasses (remove or stop using FeedResponse), or update the problem statement and UML to declare messageOnFeed() returns FeedResponse and document the FeedResponse type. Prefer making messageOnFeed() return String to preserve the original exercise contract.
